title: RemindersProviderInterfaceUpdateReminderMessage
description: Edit a reminder using its last observed revision; omitted fields are preserved.

dueDate.description: Exact due instant in RFC3339 with an explicit UTC offset. Omitted on undated reminders.

timeZone.description: IANA time zone, for example America/Los_Angeles. Defaults to UTC for newly dated reminders.

allDay.description: Whether the supplied due date represents an all-day reminder.

clearDueDate.description: Set true to remove the due date. Cannot be combined with dueDate.
